hero.headline: Meet the collective.
hero.standfirst: CLFA Collective is a network, *not a hierarchy*. But it started with two people who’ve been in every room this industry has to offer.

why.heading: Why a collective?
why.body: Cathy & Michelle knew their clients demanded something agencies weren’t serving: adaptable teams right-sized for every job, every challenge, every single time.

result.heading: The result
result.body: You get the team you actually need—calibrated, senior, and ready to move—without paying for the parts you don’t.
